title: Filtered-complex subquotients and graded cycle-boundary subobjects
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], let $K^\bullet$ be an integer-indexed cochain complex, and let $F$ be a decreasing filtration of $K^\bullet$ by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration], equivalently a decreasing filtration of $K^\bullet$ as an object of the abelian category of cochain complexes. Write $F^pK^n=\operatorname{im}((F^pK^\bullet\hookrightarrow K^\bullet)^n)$. For integers $a\le b$, define $X^{[a,b]}=\operatorname{coker}(F^bK^\bullet\hookrightarrow F^aK^\bullet)$ with quotient projection $\pi_{a,b}:F^aK^\bullet\to X^{[a,b]}$. Put $\operatorname{gr}^pK=X^{[p,p+1]}$. For integers $p,n,r$, define $\widetilde Z_r^{p,n}=F^pK^n\cap d^{-1}(F^{p+r}K^{n+1})$, viewed as a subobject of $(F^pK)^n$. Define subobjects $Z_r^{p,n}$ and $B_r^{p,n}$ of $(\operatorname{gr}^pK)^n$ by the images under $\pi_{p,p+1}^n$ of $((F^pK^n\cap d^{-1}(F^{p+r}K^{n+1}))+F^{p+1}K^n)$ and $((F^pK^n\cap d(F^{p-r+1}K^{n-1}))+F^{p+1}K^n)$, respectively, restricted to $(F^pK)^n$. Thus $Z_r^{p,n}=((F^pK^n\cap d^{-1}(F^{p+r}K^{n+1}))+F^{p+1}K^n)/F^{p+1}K^n$ and $B_r^{p,n}=((F^pK^n\cap d(F^{p-r+1}K^{n-1}))+F^{p+1}K^n)/F^{p+1}K^n$.
